title: Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM), Aligarh - Official Home - Welcome to VCTM Aligarh
heading: Welcome to VCTM Aligarh
content: Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM), Aligarh is a premier technical institution approved by AICTE, New Delhi and affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU Lucknow, College Code: 340) and Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh (BTE UP, Code: 1628). Established in 2008 by N.L. Educational Society, the college is situated on Mathura Bypass near Khair Road, 500 meters from Nada Pul, Aligarh.

title: Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM), Aligarh - Official Home - Institutional Codes
heading: Institutional Codes
content: AKTU College Code: 340 for B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, MCA. BTE UP College Code: 1628 for Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering.

title: Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM), Aligarh - Official Home - Director & Leadership

title: About Vivekananda College of Technology & Management - About the Institution
heading: About the Institution
content: Established in the year 2008 under the visionary leadership of N.L. Educational Society, Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM) has emerged as an educational hub in Western Uttar Pradesh. The lush green 10.7-acre highway campus provides modern technical education, departmental laboratories, a central library, and vibrant student amenities.

title: About Vivekananda College of Technology & Management - Vivekananda Group of Colleges
heading: Vivekananda Group of Colleges
content: The Vivekananda Group of Colleges consists of: 1. Vivekananda College of Technology & Management (VCTM, AKTU Code 340), 2. Vivekananda College of Polytechnic (VCP, BTE UP Code 1628), 3. Vivekananda College of Education (VCOE), 4. Vivekananda College of Law (VCOL).

title: About Vivekananda College of Technology & Management - Approvals & Recognitions
heading: Approvals & Recognitions
content: All engineering and management programs are approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India. Affiliated to AKTU Lucknow (College Code: 340) and BTE UP Lucknow (College Code: 1628).

title: Mission and Vision - VCTM Aligarh - Vision Statement
heading: Vision Statement
content: To be a world-class professional institution, constantly striving for excellence in education, research & technical services and developing competent, ethical, and morally strong leaders for industry & society.

title: Mission and Vision - VCTM Aligarh - Mission Statements
heading: Mission Statements
content: 1. Imparting quality education of global standards with focus on problem-solving skills. 2. Inculcating a global perspective and encouraging lifelong learning. 3. Promoting human values, ethics, and healthy professional practices. 4. Encouraging creativity, innovation, and an active research temperament. 5. Providing knowledge-based technological services to meet industry and societal needs. 6. Synergizing teaching-learning through active interaction with industry and academia.

title: Mission and Vision - VCTM Aligarh - Core Values
heading: Core Values
content: Academic excellence, integrity, outstanding teaching, scholarly research, appreciation of intellectual creativity, and sensitivity to social responsibility.

title: B.Tech Programs - Courses & Approved Intake - B.Tech Specializations
heading: B.Tech Specializations
content: VCTM offers 4-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) degree programs affiliated to AKTU (Code: 340) in: 1. Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) - 120 seats, 2. Information Technology (IT) - 60 seats, 3. Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) - 60 seats, 4. Mechanical Engineering (ME) - 60 seats, 5. Civil Engineering (CE) - 60 seats, 6. Electrical Engineering (EE) - 60 seats, 7. Agricultural Engineering - 60 seats.

title: B.Tech Programs - Courses & Approved Intake - B.Tech Fee Policy
heading: B.Tech Fee Policy
content: Tuition fees for B.Tech programs are governed by the Uttar Pradesh State Fee Regulatory Committee (Fee Fixation Committee) and AKTU guidelines. Exact session fee circulars and semester installment schedules are available directly from the VCTM Admission Cell (+91 94540 10846 / info@vctm.in) rather than static website figures. UP Post-Matric Scholarship fee reimbursement is available for eligible UP domicile students.

title: B.Tech Programs - Courses & Approved Intake - B.Tech Eligibility Criteria
heading: B.Tech Eligibility Criteria
content: 10+2 Intermediate from UP Board / CBSE / ICSE or recognized board with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or Computer Science. Minimum 45% aggregate marks (40% for SC/ST reserved categories). Admission via AKTU UPTAC counseling (JEE Main / CUET scores) or direct admission under merit / management quota.

title: B.Tech Programs - Courses & Approved Intake - B.Tech Lateral Entry
heading: B.Tech Lateral Entry
content: Direct admission into 2nd year (3rd semester) B.Tech for candidates holding a 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering with min 45% marks (40% for SC/ST) or B.Sc degree with Mathematics.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - Master of Business Administration (MBA)
heading: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
content: 2-year full-time MBA affiliated to AKTU Lucknow (Code: 340). Dual specializations available in Marketing, Financial Management, Human Resource (HR) Management, and Information Technology. Intake: 60 seats.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - MBA Fee Policy
heading: MBA Fee Policy
content: Tuition fees for MBA are governed by Uttar Pradesh State Fee Regulatory norms and university directives. Contact the Admission Cell (+91 94540 10846 / info@vctm.in) for the verified session fee circular and installment schedule.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - MBA Eligibility
heading: MBA Eligibility
content: Recognized 3-year Bachelor degree in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST reserved category). Valid CUET-PG / CAT / MAT score or direct admission.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
heading: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
content: 2-year full-time Master of Computer Applications program affiliated to AKTU (Code: 340). Intake: 60 seats. Focus on cloud computing, full-stack software development, data analytics, and modern programming.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - MCA Fee Policy
heading: MCA Fee Policy
content: Tuition fees for MCA follow the Uttar Pradesh State Fee Regulatory Committee norms. Exact fee circulars are obtained directly from the Admission Desk.

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - MCA Eligibility
heading: MCA Eligibility
content: Passed BCA, B.Sc (Computer Science / IT) or graduation in any stream with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST candidates).

title: MBA & MCA Programs - Courses & Intake - M.Tech Programs
heading: M.Tech Programs
content: 2-year M.Tech postgraduate engineering programs affiliated to AKTU Lucknow (Code: 340) in: 1. Production Engineering (18 seats), 2. Structural Engineering (18 seats). Eligibility: B.Tech / B.E in relevant branch with min 50% marks.

title: Polytechnic Diploma Programs - BTE UP Code 1628 - Polytechnic Diploma Branches
heading: Polytechnic Diploma Branches
content: 3-year Diploma in Engineering affiliated to Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh (BTE UP, College Code: 1628) in: 1. Civil Engineering, 2. Mechanical Engineering, 3. Electrical Engineering, 4. Electronics Engineering. Total Intake: 120 seats.

title: Polytechnic Diploma Programs - BTE UP Code 1628 - Polytechnic Fee Policy
heading: Polytechnic Fee Policy
content: Tuition fees for Polytechnic Diploma follow Board of Technical Education (BTE UP) and State Fee Regulatory Committee guidelines. Contact the VCTM Admission Office for verified fee circulars.

title: Polytechnic Diploma Programs - BTE UP Code 1628 - Polytechnic Eligibility
heading: Polytechnic Eligibility
content: Passed 10th High School examination from UP Board / CBSE / ICSE or recognized board with Science and Mathematics, with minimum 35% marks. Admission via JEECUP counseling or direct admission.

title: Admissions Process & Guidelines - Admission Modes
heading: Admission Modes
content: Admissions are conducted through two streams: 1. Counseling Quota (85% seats): Through AKTU UPTAC / JEECUP online counseling based on JEE Main, CUET, or JEECUP rank (AKTU Code: 340, BTE Code: 1628). 2. Direct Admission / Management Quota (15% seats): Merit-based direct admission based on 10+2 / graduation marks at the college campus admission cell.

title: Admissions Process & Guidelines - Documents Required
heading: Documents Required
content: Original and photocopies of: 10th and 12th marksheets & certificates, Graduation marksheet (for PG), Transfer Certificate (TC) & Migration Certificate, Character Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Category / Caste Certificate (if applicable), Income Certificate for scholarship, Domicile Certificate, 8 passport-size photographs, Rank scorecard of JEE Main / CUET / JEECUP.

title: Admissions Process & Guidelines - Admission Office Contacts
heading: Admission Office Contacts
content: VCTM Campus Admission Cell, Mathura Bypass, Near Khair Road, Aligarh. Phone: +91 94540 10846, +91 79064 87855, +91 97560 79797. Email: info@vctm.in.

title: Scholarships & Financial Assistance - UP Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
heading: UP Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
content: Government of Uttar Pradesh (Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) Post-Matric Scholarship provides up to 100% tuition fee reimbursement for eligible UP domicile students. Applicable to SC, ST, OBC, General, and Minority categories with family income under ₹2.0 Lakhs per annum (₹2.5 Lakhs for SC/ST). College provides dedicated scholarship cell assistance on the scholarship.up.gov.in portal.

title: Scholarships & Financial Assistance - National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
heading: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
content: Central government scholarship schemes for minority communities (Merit-cum-Means) and Pragati / Saksham scholarships by AICTE for meritorious girl students and differently-abled students.

title: Scholarships & Financial Assistance - Society Merit Concessions
heading: Society Merit Concessions
content: N.L. Educational Society offers special fee concessions for meritorious candidates with exceptional 12th percentage, sports achievers, siblings studying in Vivekananda Group of Colleges, and economically disadvantaged students.

title: Hostel, Mess & Transportation Facilities - Hostel Facilities
heading: Hostel Facilities
content: Separate on-campus secure hostels for Boys and Girls. Features include 4 vegetarian mess meals daily, 24x7 security, CCTV cameras, Wi-Fi, power backup, and purified RO drinking water. Well-furnished rooms with beds, study tables, chairs, and cupboards. Curfew time strictly enforced for student safety.

title: Hostel, Mess & Transportation Facilities - College Bus Transport
heading: College Bus Transport
content: Comprehensive fleet of college buses operating across Aligarh city and neighboring towns including Sasni, Iglas, Khair, and Hathras. All buses equipped with GPS tracking and speed governors.

title: Training & Placement Cell (CRC) - Corporate Resource Centre (CRC)
heading: Corporate Resource Centre (CRC)
content: Dedicated Corporate Resource Centre organizes campus recruitment drives, aptitude bootcamps, technical mock interviews, industrial visits, and summer internships in Delhi-NCR and industrial corridors.

title: Training & Placement Cell (CRC) - Prominent Recruiters
heading: Prominent Recruiters
content: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Genpact, HCL Technologies, Pie Infocomm, Motherson Group, Cognizant. Salary package offerings and offer counts vary by annual batch and company drive; verified placement reports can be obtained directly from the CRC Placement Cell (info@vctm.in).

title: Examinations & Academic System - Evaluation System
heading: Evaluation System
content: VCTM follows the AKTU Semester System with 2 semesters per academic year (Odd Semester: August to December, Even Semester: January to May). Continuous internal evaluation includes 2 Sessional Exams (Class Tests), assignments, quizzes, and lab assessments (30% internal weightage). End-semester theory and practical exams are conducted by AKTU Lucknow (Code: 340) / BTE UP (Code: 1628) (70% external weightage). Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory for exam admit cards.
